Mysterious forces are closing in on Planarcadia. And you, master of Cosmicon Collective, it's time to show off your card skills and teach them a lesson!

◆ Event Rules ◆
● During the event, Trailblazers will engage in Cosmicon Collective battles with familiar companions.
● In the Cosmicon Collective gameplay, players need to use collected character cards to duel against opponents, utilizing the dice attached to cards for offense and defense.
● In this event, as turns progress, weather effects will appear that influence both friend and foe on the battlefield.
● Defeating opponents will increase your Experience Level and earn you various tokens. Different tokens can be used to purchase new cards, dice, and to Gild cards.

◆ Permanent Rewards ◆
● Play matches in the Cosmicon Collective to increase your Experience Level and earn Level Rewards.
